symptom: Local follow-ups queued behind a running turn lived only in renderer memory, so a reload, quit or crash discarded them silently; only the running message survived.
rule: Local send-queue entries are journaled until they leave the queue for dispatch (a claim is not delivery) and return paused after hydrate; explicit close/reset discards the journal too. See playbooks/bug-fix.md.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/features/agent/__tests__/queue-workflow.test.ts -t 'Local queued follow-ups across a restart'
